mechanism.choice: Bun workspace membership of the sibling IECODE checkout
why: Same sibling-checkout convention as IECODE Cargo path dependencies on ../aphrody and Aphrody checkoutRoot("iecode") = ../iecode; no published registry or remote is required.
Bun links workspace members by symlink to the real IECODE sources (file: dependencies would copy and go stale; link: needs per-host registration).

Package names and import specifiers are unchanged, so consumers keep "workspace:*" and need no shim; IECODE "catalog:" dependencies resolve through the Aphrody catalog, and @rosegriffon/db / @rosegriffon/assets ^1.0.3 link to Aphrody packages/rg/{db,assets}.
consequences: bun install in Aphrody writes node_modules symlinks inside ../iecode/packages/{inagle,inagle-cross,azalee}; bun install in IECODE rewrites them to IECODE's own store (both are valid; the last install wins).
Aphrody installs, type checks and builds require the ../iecode checkout (override with APHRODY_IECODE_ROOT for the Next build root).

RG website: Turbopack root and output tracing root are the common parent of both checkouts, so the standalone server is .next/standalone/<aphrody dir name>/apps/rg/website/server.js; scripts/rg/next-build.sh computes it.
@aphrody/agent-browser is an optional peer of @rosegriffon/inagle: linked inside Aphrody, absent in a standalone IECODE install.
